name: Novotel Rayong Star Convention Centre
short_description: A convention-focused Novotel with function rooms for up to 1,500 guests, a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (1,066 reviews), near Rayong's beach, shopping, and industrial estate.
ai_summary: Novotel Rayong Star Convention Centre combines Novotel's family-friendly midscale positioning with function rooms accommodating up to 1,500 guests, serving Rayong's business and MICE market alongside leisure travellers. The property holds a strong 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 1,066 reviews. It's ideally located near the beach, shopping centres, restaurants, night markets, and Rayong's industrial estate, with a kids club, playground, and social hub area for families. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 109 Sukhumvit Road, Tha Pradu, Muang Rayong District, 21000 Rayong, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Excellent 4.7/5 ALL Rating from a substantial 1,066-review base
Function rooms for up to 1,500 guests — a genuine convention/MICE draw for the Eastern Seaboard
Kids club, playground, and social hub area alongside proximity to the beach and shopping
cons: Positioned primarily for business/MICE travellers — leisure guests wanting a resort-first experience may prefer the beachfront Novotel Rayong Rim Pae Resort instead
research_highlights: Function rooms for up to 1,500 guests; kids club and playground
